remarks: Prime location! This stunning and spacious second-floor apartment offers everything you need. Featuring four generously sized bedrooms, and two beautifully designed full bathrooms with custom-made Shaker cabinets. Enjoy the elegance of hardwood floors throughout, bright eat-in kitchen, complete with a stainless steel refrigerator, flows effortlessly into the sunlit dining and living areas, leading to a spacious sunroom. A convenient mudroom provides extra storage to keep your space organized. Washer and dryer are included in the unit for added convenience. Located close to grocery stores, restaurants, pharmacies, many nearby amenities with easy access to the Merritt Parkway and Route 7. Reserved parking spaces included!
